destination.question: Where would you like to sail?
destination.subtitle: Choose a destination or let us suggest the best option for you

croatia.label: Croatia
croatia.description: Best for island hopping & first-time sailing. Calm waters, short distances between islands, and a huge variety of routes — perfect for beginners and relaxed trips.

greece.label: Greece
greece.description: Best for scenic routes & cultural mix. Sail through iconic islands with crystal-clear water, historic towns, and a balance of adventure and comfort.

italy.label: Italy
italy.description: Best for premium experiences & coastline views. Beautiful coastal routes, high-end marinas, and unforgettable destinations like Amalfi — ideal for a more luxurious trip.

spain.label: Spain
spain.description: Best for lifestyle & social vibes. Great weather, vibrant atmosphere, and destinations like Ibiza or Mallorca — perfect for fun, groups, and active trips.

groupSize.question: How many people are joining?
groupSize.subtitle: Group size affects yacht type, space, and total price per person

twoToFour.label: 2–4 people
twoToFour.description: More privacy, higher cost per person

fiveToEight.label: 5–8 people
fiveToEight.description: Best balance of comfort and price

ninePlus.label: 9+ people
ninePlus.description: Requires larger yachts or multiple boats

experience.question: Do you have sailing experience?
experience.subtitle: A skipper can be added at any level — this only decides who steers.

none.label: No experience
none.description: I need a skipper to sail the boat

some.label: Some experience
some.description: I have sailed before, but need a skipper

licensed.label: Licensed
licensed.description: I have a valid license and will sail myself

tripVibe.question: What kind of trip are you looking for?
tripVibe.subtitle: What you want out of the week shapes the boat, the route and the pace.

adventure.label: Adventure
adventure.description: Active sailing and exploration. More movement, longer routes, and hands-on sailing

relax.label: Relax
relax.description: Slow pace, nature, and quiet bays. Perfect for calm sailing, swimming, and disconnecting.

family.label: Family
family.description: Safe, comfortable, and spacious. Ideal for kids, stability, and easy routes.

luxury.label: Luxury
luxury.description: Premium yachts and full-service experience. Crew, comfort, and high-end destinations.

party.label: Party
party.description: Music, nightlife, and social atmosphere. Best for Ibiza-style routes and group energy.

duration.question: How long would you like your trip to be?
duration.subtitle: Choose the duration that best fits your plans. This helps us suggest the right yachts, routes, and overall experience.

budget.question: What budget feels comfortable?
budget.subtitle: Per person for a week aboard, so you can compare it with a holiday you know.
